visual_review: A Latin cross stands in an open palm-up hand (the library's hand-holding-heart palm); the hand reads clearly at 48 in both themes and the long lower upright keeps the cross from reading as a plus.
omissions: The second hand and the outlined cross body; two upright hands with a separate thumb do not fit 40 units at 8-unit spacing, and an outlined cross would crowd the palm.
